t: Here is the London Eye, the cantilevered observation wheel on the South Bank of the Thames. Originally called the Millennium Wheel, it is the world's tallest wheel of its kind, and the most popular paid tourist attraction in the United Kingdom, with more than three million visitors a year. It was designed by the architects Julia Barfield and David Marks, a married couple who ran Marks Barfield Architects. Marks also designed the i360 tower in Brighton and the Treetop Walkway at Kew Gardens.
